newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's trade deficit stands at $671.7 mln/Q1.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's trade deficit stands at $671.7 mln/Q1.

text.p: Morocco's trade deficit dropped 8.7 percent to 6.24 billion dirhams ($671.7 million) in the first quarter of the year compared with the same period in 1995, the Statistics Directorate said.
In its monthly news letter received on Tuesday, the directorate said trade deficit was 6.83 billion dirhams in the first three months of 1995.
Exports rose 10.2 percent to 14.6 billion dirhams in the first quarter of 1996 compared with the first quarter of the previous year, it said.
Phosphates and by-products export rose 47.8 percent to 3.0 billion dirhams in the first three months of the year compared with the same period of 1995, it said.
Imports rose slightly 3.8 percent to 20.9 billion dirhams compared with the first quarter of 1995, it said.
Crude oil purchase was up to 2.07 billion dirhams in the first quarter of 1996 from 1.22 billion dirhams in same period the previous year.
Foreign exchange cover ratio was 70.1 percent in the first quarter against 66.1 percent in the same period in 1995, the directorate added .
